summary: The headline balanced nine-variable NL242 question is unresolved. Verified scoped results give the elementary global alternatives {240,242}, degree-eight necessity, radius-six exclusions around five inequivalent explicit seeds, restricted 16/32/64/128-point maxima 240, and exact maximum 240 in 31492 listed fixed-half classes. The other 252 screened half-classes remain unresolved. Missing historical certificates are not used. Novelty is unknown.

claims.statement: The maximum balanced nonlinearity on nine variables is either 240 or 242. Every balanced function of degree at most seven has nonlinearity at most 240, with equality for x0+x1*x2+x3*x4+x5*x6+x7*x8. Any target has degree exactly eight and nonzero support XOR. The global upper bound uses a separate nonzero-support-XOR case and is independent of the cited unrefereed covering-radius claim.

The three explicit hex tables in code/seeds.py have weights 250,250,242, nonlinearity 242, and no Walsh zero. Their forced balancing distances at the original origin are 6,6,14, and the minimum over linear output shifts is 2 for each. Their absolute autocorrelation indicators are respectively 40,32,56. Therefore they are pairwise not extended-affine equivalent, although their absolute Walsh histograms coincide.

For each explicit table dsbf40, dsbf32, rsbf56 in code/seeds.py, no modification at Hamming distance at most four followed by any linear output addition is both balanced and of nonlinearity at least 242. All 130816 pairs per seed fail the bound 28. Exhausting all 22238720 triples per seed gives 195 admissible triples and exactly 45 bound-preserving four-sets, none with a Walsh zero. Both the producer and independent checker exhaust the full ranges. Original forced distances are 6,6,14; over linear shifts they are 2,2,2, so the shifted exclusion is non-vacuous.

Allow arbitrary changes on the specified 16-point affine four-flat of each seed, followed by any linear output addition. Each of these three restricted classes has exact balanced maximum nonlinearity 240. All 65536 assignments per seed were independently checked at all 512 Walsh indices and compared to a separate 16-point transform reduction. Each class has 448 tables preserving bound 28, none with a zero. Explicit balanced 240 attainers are included.

For each seed and its explicit V in two-coset-proof.md, allow arbitrary changes on any pair of distinct V-cosets and then any linear output addition. The exact balanced maximum in each restricted union is 240. All 496 pairs per seed are covered by complete 65536-entry half catalogues and exact finite bitset intersections covering all 2^32 assignments per pair. The independent checker reconstructs the full catalogues by direct sums and audits every original character-block identity and inequality. Each pair containing the core has 448 bound-preserving assignments; each other pair has one; none has a Walsh zero. Counts across pairs have multiplicity.

The three explicit Section 3.1 seeds have no exact-six modification with all Walsh magnitudes <=28 and any Walsh zero. Independent exhaustive hypergraph enumeration covers all 22238720 triples and all six-set extensions per seed: 195 candidates, 120 preserving all bounds, zero with a Walsh zero. With the separate radius-four exclusion and parity, this excludes balanced NL>=242 throughout radius six followed by any linear output addition. Original forced distances:6,6,14; shifted minimum:2 each. Missing old LRAT proofs are not used.

Exactly two specified classes have exact balanced maximum 240, allowing arbitrary changes on their domains and every linear output addition: dsbf40 on 5+span(27,45,195,325,1,2), 64 free points; dsbf32 on span(63,90,139,278,1,2,4), 128 free points. Each has a universally audited integer-FWHT encoding and independently checked LRAT empty-clause certificate, plus a checked bound-32 planted SAT model and balanced NL240 attainer. The former twelve-quarter-class assertion is withdrawn.

For the explicit Section 4 tables perm104-ac48 and perm74-ac64 in code/extra_seeds.py, no distance<=6 modification followed by any linear output shift is balanced with NL>=242. All pairs, triples and six-extensions are independently exhausted. No pairs or fours preserve bound 28; there are no saturated-constraint six-candidates. Weights:270,246; original forced balancing distances:14,10; shifted minima:2 each. Indicators 48,64 distinguish these seeds from each other and from the original three. This excludes explicit neighborhoods, not entire symmetry classes.

For an odd-weight eight-variable restriction g with spectrum G, any completion with max|W|<=28 and a Walsh zero requires max|G|<=26 and ||G||_1<=3570+max{|G(b)|:|G(b)|<=14}. The self-contained proof applied to all 31744 listed pairs from 124 explicit balanced NL240 sources proves exact balanced maximum 240 in 31492 specified 256-free-point classes, allowing every linear output addition. The remaining 252 classes are unresolved by this screen. Every source and restriction is independently checked by direct sums; every class has an NL240 attainer and a bound-32 planted control. Classes can overlap and are not claimed affine-inequivalent. This is not a global exclusion.

next_step: Search the 252 explicit half-classes passing the necessary-condition screen, or develop a construction/proof for arbitrary degree-eight tables. UNKNOWN and uncertified negative statuses imply no exclusion; global maximum 240 versus 242 is unresolved in this attempt.
